title: Spirit Direction
content:
At the time I went through in spirit as water in a mountain and was drawn out by Jesus' thought and authority. He directed my spirit and has shown me the light and how to use the energy. He continues to keep me sober.

The next thing he did was direct me to the onyx, a very beautiful stone and to the light. It had water in it which he directed me into and the light as well. His voice was like wind. The colors were very intense. His image was very healthy. The atmosphere was heavenly. Later the experience gets better.
